text:
marta: Heads-up — saw a spike of streaming stalls from EU edge starting ~09:20 UTC, clients reconnecting in tight loops and our console shows a flurry of 204 proxy responses. :eyes:
kevin: repro steps? any sample trace ids?
marta: threw a sample from a customer (trace 0a1b2c). pattern: SSE connection receives a truncated last-chunk, client reconnects → duplicate session created, billing shows two active tokens for same logical session.
ashley: that sounds like the old resume vs sticky-route mismatch. Are we falling back to a quick reconnect policy that spins up a new route instead of trying resume?
kevin: looks like routing policy decided route was unhealthy and issued a route-swap. resume-id got stripped by proxy 204 path. we have code that treats 204 as terminal and clears resume metadata.
sam: is this the case where the proxy responds with empty body + 204 during late preflight? we saw something similar but assumed client libs handled de-dupe.
marta: client lib tries resume if resume-id present. but resume-id is missing from subsequent subscribe because proxy removed it. then new route issues a brand new session and token accounting increments.
console-bot: (automated) alert: streaming_dup_sessions_eu increased by 220% in last 5m. top routes: /v1/stream-gen.
ashley: telemetry gap here — we don't attribute the 204->route-swap decision in the same timeline as the billing increment. console heatmap only shows per-route rates, not "route-swap events". makes debugging painful.
kevin: proposal: emit an event metric when proxy answers 204 that includes resume-id present/stripped + route-decision tag. then link that in console trace timeline.
sam: also add a short-lived quarantine flag: when we see a resume attempt fail due to missing resume metadata, mark the client as "quarantine:resume-missing" and hold replay for 2s before creating new session. reduces dup charges for flappy networks.
marta: UX ask: in the Console session view show "resume attempts" as a small timeline under each session so SREs can see quick dups. Right now you have to cross-correlate logs.
ashley: agree. minimal console change: show a delta badge on session list that says "X resume failures" and a hover that links to raw events.
kevin: quick implementation plan: 1) infra: metric + event emitted from proxy (infra-bot to do), 2) backend: store resume attempts as session sub-events, 3) console: show badge + timeline.
infra-bot: ack — will add metric name proxy.sse.204_resume_strip {tags: region, route, resume_present_before, resume_present_after}. ETA ~2d for metric and 1 week for event log retention increase.
sam: small caution — quarantine window must be conservative for low-latency customers. test with canary for 48h and add a rollout toggle.
marta: can we add a quick server-side feature flag and a console toggle for SREs to flip the quarantine behavior per-tenant?
kevin: yes — per-tenant config exists under routing.policies.stream_quarantine_ms. default 0. we'll set default 2000ms for EU canary.
ashley: last ask — billing side: add dedupe window when we see resumed session id followed by new session for same token within 5s, treat as same session for metering. ops: write a short playbook for customers hit by duplicates.
kevin: noted. I'll open PRs: proxy metric + event, backend event ingestion, billing dedupe rule, console badge. tag: @eng-runtime @eng-sre for rollout plan.
marta: thanks — filing an incident note and will follow up with traces. :thumbsup:
